title: Alcohol-Free Day Streak
dataSources: Alcohol drinks (`alcohol:drink`), vice logs (`vice:log`), hydration intake (`hydration:intake`), swear-jar entries (`swearjar:entry`).
app: Habit and sobriety trackers, alcohol-unit and hydration logs, vaping/smoking cessation apps, and a smart swear jar — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=alcohol:drink
| bin _time span=1d
| stats sum(units) as units by _time
| streamstats current=t sum(eval(if(units=0,1,0))) as dry_streak reset_after="(units>0)"
| sort - _time
description: Counts your current run of alcohol-free days, turning cutting back into a streak you want to protect.
value: A dry-day streak gamifies moderation, making an alcohol-free evening a small win rather than a sacrifice.
implementation: Log drinks into `index=personal`; schedule daily and surface the current alcohol-free streak.
visualization: Single-value tile of the current alcohol-free-day streak.
grandmaExplanation: It counts how many days in a row you have gone without alcohol, making cutting back feel like a winning streak.
